:::{#exm-binomial-two}
#### Pairs from three and from five elements
<!-- no-figure: arithmetic on two small cases; nothing to plot -->

By @thm-binomial-two,
$\binomial{3}{2} = \frac{3 \cdot 2}{2} = 3$,
which matches the three subsets listed in @exm-binomial-coefficient.
Likewise $\binomial{5}{2} = \frac{5 \cdot 4}{2} = 10$,
the number of ways to pick two different toppings from five in @sol-toppings.

:::
